name: Pink Acai Original Pod | 1g
description:
Extracted from a variety of natural flora, STIIIZY’s naturally derived terpenes offer balanced aroma to deliver quality experience every time. Our premium concentrates uphold a high level of purity, setting the industry standard to influence and inspire through innovative methods.

Pink Acai is a hybrid with a berry-forward profile, tropical notes, and earthy undertones.
